summary_en: Mito Securities authorized acquisition of up to 1.0 million shares (1.7% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥800 million through trust-based market purchases from October 30 to December 23, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Resolution of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 29, 2026, Mito Securities' board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 1.0 million shares of its common stock, representing 1.7% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock. The maximum acquisition cost is set at ¥800 million. The company will conduct purchases through a trust-based market purchase method during the period from October 30 to December 23, 2026.

The company stated that it adopted this authorization based on a comprehensive review of its financial condition and stock price levels. The board determined that acquiring treasury stock would serve to enhance overall shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency. The company's acquisition policy prioritizes flexibility, adjusting the timing and scale of repurchases in response to market conditions and business performance.
